text:
Alex M: Quick heads-up — I want to start a staggered activation for the ff/batch_kv_v2 change (KV prefetch + batching tweaks). Planning: internal -> beta -> prod. Need to lock scope, guardrails, and rollback steps.

Taylor: +1. Can you call out the exact metrics we'll watch? p95 token latency, p50, error rate, and any cache-miss amplification signals? Also need a PR link for the flag toggle. :eyes:

Alex M: PR is here: https://git.redwood/infra/ff/1234 — it's just the rollout gating. Main risks: increased p95 for short requests and potential bursty CPU during prefetch. Guardrail ideas: p95 <= 220ms (hosted default), errors <= 0.7%, backend CPU < 75% per pod.

Priya R: For audiences: start with `team-infra` + `canary` orgs (internal dev + 2 customers), then 5% synthetic traffic, then 10-25% live routing if stable. Keep the beta window 2 hours with automated rollback if guardrail exceeded.

Sam O: I'll add a small probe suite: 3 synthetic flows — short-chat (<=128 tokens), long-gen (>=1024 tokens), and hot-key workload (many small keys). We'll check KV hit rate, request CPU, p95, and token throughput. Suggest exposing a delta chart vs baseline (last 24h).

Alex M: Good. Proposed rollout snippet for Launchpad (config for ops):
```json
{ "flag": "ff/batch_kv_v2", "steps": [{"audience": "team-infra", "pct": 0}, {"audience": "beta-orgs", "pct": 0}, {"audience": "synthetic-traffic", "pct": 5}, {"audience": "prod-gradual", "pct": 25}], "guardrails": {"p95_latency_ms": 220, "error_rate_pct": 0.7, "cpu_pct": 75} }
```

Taylor: Minor ask — include a canary heatmap for region-level failures. If a region goes >1.2x baseline p95 or error spike >2x, auto-drain and rollback that region.

Priya R: Agree. Also add a short-circuit toggle path: if customer SLA label == "enterprise-high" route to ff/batch_kv_v2=false always. Avoid impacting paying customers.

Alex M: Noted. Rollback plan: immediate global rollback (flip flag off) + traffic migration to legacy model variant. Ops runbook will include commands: `./deployctl toggle ff/batch_kv_v2 off --scope all` and `./trafficctl promote model=baseline`.

Sam O: I'll prepare the dashboard tiles: p95, p50, error rate, CPU per pod, KV hit ratio, and a diff vs baseline. Also will add an alert: trigger Slack @eng-runtime if p95 delta > 40ms for 3 consecutive 1-min windows.

canary-bot: Scheduled canary window: 2026-03-18T10:00:00Z - will run synthetic probes at start + every 10m. Auto-rollback threshold set to p95 >= 220ms for 5m or error_rate >= 0.7% for 5m.

Taylor: Do we need a canary cohort for cold-start models? This affects KV warm caches. Maybe add a 5min warmup stage where traffic is replayed to populate caches before measuring.

Priya R: Yes — add a warmup step with traffic replay for 10 minutes, then start measurements. Also note customers on dedicated pools should be excluded by default.

Alex M: Final checklist before enabling: 1) dashboards ready (Sam) 2) ops runbook & rollback commands posted (I'll draft) 3) PR merged and toggle audited (Taylor) 4) canary-bot scheduled (done) 5) warmup traffic configured (Priya). Targeting 10:00Z tomorrow.

Taylor: I'll review the PR and audit the toggle. Ping me when dashboards are up.

Priya R: I'll set up the warmup replay and confirm dedicated pool exclusion.

Sam O: Dashboards ETA: 2 hours. I'll post links here when ready.

Alex M: Thanks — will update this thread with runbook and final go/no-go 30m before start. :thumbsup:
